reviews.text: Everyone is very nice, nice clean environment.

We are in the best place, we love Dr. Mucsi-Besze Anna very much, we have been going here since this veterinary clinic was opened.
My dog ​​Mazsi is very difficult, she has not worked with a single veterinarian before, but Dr. Mucsi-Besze Anna is so nice, our dog feels completely safe and does not object to the examinations.
The female doctor has saved our dog many times, thank you very much🤗
We thank Dr. Mucsi-Besze Anna for everything 🤗😘❤️
We recommend Szemfüles Veterinary Clinic to everyone.

Thorough, conscientious examination, friendly atmosphere, card payment option, a special plus point is the online appointment booking, so you can avoid long waits with other animals in the waiting room. Easy accessibility, easy parking.

I have brought many pets here for examination and spaying. The doctors are very kind and conscientious; most recently they found me an appointment for an urgent spay.

Booking an appointment is quick and easy on the website. I also really like the animal-shaped objects and framed pictures in the office, which only make the place even friendlier.

We have never experienced such a kind and conscientious veterinary clinic...it's like a dream! Our puppy was not afraid, we will bring both of them here. Dear both doctors, I have been more excited about the treatment in all the clinics so far, and the real cure of the problem, disease...now we are here again because of the result of a surgery that went wrong elsewhere. Our puppy is treated as if it were a little child! With all the love and kindness! We have transferred here permanently! And we are grateful for everything!
Very friendly and highly professional medical team! Thank you very much!

Dear Everyone!
We recently adopted our dog, who had almost no known health issues before, in addition to the specific mandatory vaccinations and other things.
We also received very precise and timely lab and general examinations from them! ❤️❤️
After all, I want to start our new family member's life with a "complete clean slate"! They were extraordinary in everything! ❤️
The oral hygiene, the removal of broken teeth and other small things were very spectacular! I am happy and so is the dog! ❤️
This little clinic is worth everything!
They are thorough and very detailed, kind in every way! Thank you!

Tamás & Barbara
Thank you for your work, such a good clinic is rare these days 🙏 professionally outstanding and not running on a treadmill.... …

They are very kind to animals and people. They answer all questions kindly and explain everything clearly.
I can only recommend them.
I made the worst decision of my life. Without it, I was left with emptiness and immeasurable pain.
